stem.en: At ₹150 per kg, Seller A offers 3 kg, Seller B offers 7 kg and Seller C offers 8 kg. What is the market supply at ₹150 per kg?

text.en: 8 kg, because the seller who offers the most sets the market supply.
6 kg, because that is how much a typical seller offers at that price.
18 kg, because we add what all three sellers offer at that price.
12 kg, because that is the market supply in the middle row of the table.

explanation.en: Market supply adds what every seller offers at the same price: 3 + 7 + 8 = 18 kg. One seller, or an average seller, tells us about one stall, not the whole market. 12 kg is the market supply at a different price, ₹100.

hints.en: Stay at one price, and add what every seller offers there.
